speaker: Unknown
en: In recent years, the main impact of AI has been on the digital world, and most notably software engineering.
zh: 近年来，AI 的主要影响一直是在数字世界，尤其是在软件工程领域。

speaker: Unknown
en: However, its longer-term effect on the physical world may prove even more profound, reshaping how cars drive themselves, how factories run, and how robots move through homes and warehouses.
zh: 然而，它对物理世界的长期影响可能会更加深远，重塑汽车如何自动驾驶、工厂如何运转，以及机器人如何在家庭和仓库中移动。

speaker: Unknown
en: World models are at the center of the movement to bring AI into the physical space.
zh: 世界模型是将 AI 带入物理空间这一运动的核心。

speaker: Unknown
en: These models take in observations of the current state of the world and predict what comes next, which lets a robot plan its next move or car anticipate the road ahead.
zh: 这些模型接收对世界当前状态的观察，并预测接下来会发生什么，这让机器人能够规划下一步动作，或者让汽车预判前方的路况。

speaker: Unknown
en: NVIDIA has been building a family of these models called Cosmos and sits at the frontier of physical AI and robotics.
zh: NVIDIA 一直在构建一系列这样的模型，称为 Cosmos，并且处于物理 AI 和机器人技术的前沿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Amit Goel has been at NVIDIA for 15 years, and he is currently the Head of Robotics Ecosystem and Edge AI product.
zh: Amit Goel 在 NVIDIA 已经工作了 15 年，他目前是机器人生态系统和边缘 AI 产品负责人。

speaker: Unknown
en: In this episode, Amit joins Matt Merrill to discuss what separates physical AI from digital AI, how world models plan and predict, the two-tower architecture that lets a robot reason and act at once, why training on video demanded a new data pipeline, and how any developer can start building in this space.
zh: 在本期节目中，Amit 与 Matt Merrill 一起讨论：物理 AI 与数字 AI 的区别、世界模型如何进行规划和预测、让机器人能够同时推理和行动的双塔架构、为什么在视频上训练需要全新的数据管线，以及任何开发者如何开始在这个领域中构建。

speaker: Unknown

zh: Matt Merrill 是一位软件工程负责人，拥有超过 20 年在企业级和以产品为中心的组织中构建和扩展软件团队的经验。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when NVIDIA or anybody says physical AI, what do you mean?
zh: 那么，当 NVIDIA 或任何人说物理 AI 时，你指的是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: What makes it different from LLMs and coding agents that most of our listeners are using every day?
zh: 是什么让它不同于我们大多数听众每天都在使用的 LLM 和编码智能体？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, the big difference between LLMs or in general digital AI and physical AI is that
zh: 是的，LLM 或者一般意义上的数字 AI 与物理 AI 的最大区别在于

speaker: Unknown
en: You're working with atoms.
zh: 你打交道的是原子。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

zh: 如果你住在旧金山湾区，你会看到 Waymo 到处行驶。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's probably the closest way to think about physical AI in the real world, right?
zh: 所以这可能是思考现实世界中物理 AI 最直观的方式，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: You have a machine that is taking the information from the cameras, the lidars, and the actuators in the car.
zh: 你有一台机器，它从摄像头、激光雷达以及车内的执行器获取信息。

speaker: Unknown
en: And making a decision on what it should do next based on what the driver wants out of the car, right?
zh: 然后基于驾驶员对车辆的需求，做出下一步该做什么的决策，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's taking the data from the observations from the physical world and determining actions that have to be executed in the physical world.
zh: 所以它是从物理世界的观察中获取数据，并确定必须在物理世界中执行的动作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's been around for a while.
zh: 而且它已经存在一段时间了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The simplest form is probably your Nest thermostat that's controlling the temperature of things in your house based on your activity.
zh: 最简单的形式可能就是你家的 Nest 恒温器，它根据你的活动来控制家里的温度。

speaker: Unknown
en: And even like a small traffic intersection that's observing what's the activity that's happening and controlling that particular traffic light.
zh: 甚至像一个小型交通路口，它在观察正在发生的活动，并控制那个特定的红绿灯。

speaker: Unknown
en: So physical AI has been around for a while, but it's been very narrowly defined for one particular use case.
zh: 所以物理 AI 已经存在一段时间了，但它一直被非常狭义地定义为某一个特定用例。

speaker: Unknown
en: So now what's happening with the large, really large models and general models is that you can have a single model that can understand all of this.
zh: 而现在随着超大模型和通用模型的出现，你可以拥有一个能够理解这一切的单一模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And similar to what happens with LLM, right?
zh: 这类似于 LLM 领域发生的情况，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't have a sentiment analysis model.
zh: 你不再需要一个专门的情感分析模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't have a translation model.
zh: 不再需要一个专门的翻译模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't have a summarization model.
zh: 不再需要一个专门的摘要模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have one big model that understands everything in the texture world and you can program it to do what you want it to do.
zh: 你有一个理解纹理世界一切的大模型，你可以对它编程让它做你想做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are getting to the point where we can build these general physical intelligence models that you can use for a lot of application in the physical world.
zh: 我们正在到达这样一个节点：可以构建这些通用的物理智能模型，你可以在物理世界中用于很多应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Got it.
zh: 明白了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I never really thought about that.
zh: 我以前真的没想过这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like a self-driving car or even a Nest thermostat is technically physical AI.
zh: 比如自动驾驶汽车，甚至 Nest 恒温器，严格来说都是物理 AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: But when I was prepping for this, seeing some of the stuff that is currently happening is so much more advanced than that.
zh: 但我在为这期节目做准备时，看到目前正在进行的一些东西比那先进得多。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 你能跟大家讲讲这个概念，它在这里如何契合，以及它可能如何驱动这样一台设备吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, so the way to think about the world model is in the context of what are the inputs and what are the outputs, right?
zh: 好，理解世界模型的方式是，从输入是什么、输出是什么的角度来思考，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So for a world model, the inputs are observations of the current state of the world.
zh: 对于世界模型来说，输入是对世界当前状态的观测。

speaker: Unknown
en: It could be a sensor coming data from a motor of a car, of a robot.
zh: 它可能是来自汽车电机、机器人的传感器传来的数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: It could be a signal that is audio command that has been given as an input.
zh: 它可能是作为输入给出的音频指令信号。

speaker: Unknown
en: It could be a textual prompt.
zh: 它可能是文本提示。

speaker: Unknown
en: And of course, it has to have the cameras and the visual representation of the world that's coming into it.
zh: 当然，它还必须有摄像头以及输入进来的世界的视觉表征。

speaker: Unknown
en: The next question is, what does the world model predict, right?
zh: 下一个问题是，世界模型预测什么，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And inherently, the world model, because it's dealing with the physics of the world, is a physical AI model.
zh: 而本质上，世界模型因为它处理的是世界的物理规律，是一个物理 AI 模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is multimodal because the real world has multiple modalities, right?
zh: 它是多模态的，因为真实世界有多种模态，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: We are hearing, we are listening, we are processing information.
zh: 我们在听，我们在倾听，我们在处理信息。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's multimodal, many inputs and also many outputs.
zh: 所以它是多模态的，有很多输入，也有很多输出。

speaker: Unknown
en: The typical output of a world model is
zh: 世界模型的典型输出是

speaker: Unknown
en: A video, which given a prompt, given a current state, if the world model understands what happens in the world, it can predict based on what you told me, this is what's likely to happen.
zh: 一段视频，即给定一个提示、给定一个当前状态，如果世界模型理解世界上会发生什么，它就可以基于你告诉我的内容预测：这就是可能发生的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the case of a car, you can say, I'm going at this particular speed.
zh: 以汽车为例，你可以说，我正以这个特定速度行驶。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is what I see is happening around me.
zh: 这是我看到的发生在我周围的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: Tell me what is likely going to be the state of the world in the next five seconds.
zh: 告诉我未来五秒钟世界可能是什么状态。

speaker: Unknown
en: Based on that, I can then control the car to what action it should take.
zh: 基于这一点，我就可以控制汽车该采取什么行动。

speaker: Unknown
en: Same analogy applies to a robot, right?
zh: 同样的类比也适用于机器人，对吧？

speaker: Unknown

zh: 你让我拿起这个东西放到那边去。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is what I see is my current state of everything around me.
zh: 这是我看到的我周围一切事物的当前状态。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the object that I see.
zh: 这是我看到的那个物体。

speaker: Unknown
en: How should I move?
zh: 我该怎么移动？

speaker: Unknown

zh: 我该往左吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Should I go right?
zh: 我该往右吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Should I go backwards?
zh: 我该往后退吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do I need to bend?

speaker: Unknown
en: It can predict what is the next few things it needs to do.
zh: 它可以预测接下来几步需要做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the world models can predict the world around you.
zh: 所以世界模型可以预测你周围的世界。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 这是我的目标。

zh: 我怎么到那里？

zh: 我们在脑子里思考的东西，叫做规划，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So the world models can predict the plan to go from the current state
zh: 所以世界模型可以预测从当前状态

speaker: Unknown
en: To the desired state.
zh: 到期望状态的规划。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is essentially the planning function of the word model.
zh: 所以这本质上就是世界模型的规划功能。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the other thing is you can say, hey, this is my current state.
zh: 另一件事是，你可以说，嘿，这是我的当前状态。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm planning to take this action.
zh: 我计划采取这个行动。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you tell me what is going to happen if I do this?
zh: 你能告诉我,如果我这么做会发生什么吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: And that is super important for robotics, right?
zh: 这对机器人技术来说超级重要,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Like if you can say, I'm going to do this and tell me what's going to happen, you can actually decide whether that's the right thing to do or not.

speaker: Unknown

en: Yeah.

speaker: Unknown
en: Because just a video of 15 minutes is several gigabytes of data.
zh: 因为仅仅 15 分钟的视频就是好几个 GB 的数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: So of course, the amount of data that gets processed in a world model is a lot.
zh: 所以,当然,世界模型中处理的数据量是很大的。

speaker: Unknown
